articleBlocks: At first, Tea, Soup, and Silver did not look like one clean idea.
My first instinct was something around dining or table settings.
That held for a moment, especially with Soup and Silver in the mix.
But Measuring made the set feel less decorative and more functional.
The real turn came with Table (3×Tea most places).
Once I read that clue as tablespoon, the shared word finally showed itself.
After that, teaspoon, soup spoon, silver spoon, and measuring spoon all snapped into place.
The answer was Words that come before "spoon".
From there, the board stopped feeling thematic and started feeling exact.
Looking back, this is one of those Pinpoint sets that seems obvious only after the key phrase appears.
